consolidate-agent-memories.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run memory consolidation. Working directory is ${SRC_ROOT}. Scan all sub-project memory dirs under ~/.claude/projects/Q--src*/memory/, compare against root memory at ~/.claude/projects/Q--src/memory/, copy new/updated files with ext_ prefix, remove duplicates, update MEMORY.md index (keep under 200 lines), run permission audit, root hygiene, stale file cleanup, and report template audit (scan all agent .md files under ~/.claude/agents/ and job configs under ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/jobs/*.json to verify HTML reports have VO subtitle, dark theme, Segoe UI, and are self-contained). If no meaningful work was done (no new memories found, no duplicates removed, no conflicts detected, and no stale files cleaned), do NOT generate an HTML report -- just output 'Memory consolidation: no changes found.' and exit. Only generate a full report when at least one memory was added, updated, deduplicated, or cleaned up. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/auditor-memory-consolidation.html. Read the template file, then replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values with actual data. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Auditor | Job: consolidate-agent-memories | Start: <PST timestamp when job started> | Complete: <PST timestamp when report is generated>. Save the report to ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/session_management/memory-report-YYYYMMDD.html.
consolidate-agent-memories.description: Consolidates all sub-project memories into root, deduplicates, generates HTML report

teams-posting-audit.prompt: IMPORTANT: Read ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md Rule #8 and Rule #9 first. Run a Teams posting permission audit across all VO agent definitions and job configs. Scan: (1) All agent .md files in ~/.claude/agents/*.md -- search for keywords: Teams, channel, post, message, Graph API, graph.microsoft.com, chatMessage, @mention, agency copilot, send, notify. (2) All job configs in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/jobs/*.json -- same keywords. (3) All runner scripts in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/runner/ -- same keywords. For EACH match found, classify as: AUTHORIZED (poster agent job with explicit channel ID + fixed template in templates/), READ-ONLY (Graph API GET for data ingestion, not posting), DEPRECATED (has explicit deprecation note), or VIOLATION (unauthorized posting instruction -- any agent other than poster that posts to Teams, any posting without explicit channel ID, any posting without a fixed template). File a GitHub issue in jqxcode/virtual-office for each VIOLATION found, with the file path, line number, exact text, and recommended fix. If no violations found, output 'Teams posting audit: all clear.' and exit. Do NOT generate an HTML report for this job.
teams-posting-audit.description: Weekly audit of all agent defs and job configs for unauthorized Teams posting instructions

agent-brain-health-check.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run the agent-brain-health-check job. First run: python ${REPO_PERSONAL}/agent-brain/scripts/health_check.py and capture all output. Then collect additional metrics: session archive coverage (sessions/ count vs ~/.claude/projects/ JSONL count), knowledge card freshness, last 10 git commits, audit log entries this week, entity counts. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/auditor-agent-brain-health-check.html. Read the template file, then replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values with actual data. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Auditor | Job: agent-brain-health-check | Start: <PST timestamp when job started> | Complete: <PST timestamp when report is generated>. Use color thresholds: Green (sync <24h, digest <7d, 0 issues, all tests pass), Yellow (sync 24-48h, digest 7-14d, 1-2 issues), Red (sync >48h, digest >14d, 3+ issues, test failures). Save report to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/auditor/agent-brain-health-YYYYMMDD.html (MUST be inside output/auditor/). Also save to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/auditor/agent-brain-health-latest.html. Open the report in Edge after generation.
agent-brain-health-check.description: Weekly Agent Brain ecosystem health check with HTML dashboard report
